purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Mahesana District Administration lists SLR and DILR land-record offices. Gujarat Revenue Department material provides official Record of Rights, property-card and city-survey procedure links. No safe anonymous parcel-vector schema, native identity response, CRS, or full polygon was obtained; no GeoJSON sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Mahesana local/state land-record custody is evidenced by the district SLR/DILR directory and Gujarat Revenue Department service pages. These establish registry/procedure context, not an open city-scoped parcel feature service.
